## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | **yes** | The amount received, in minor units. |
| `currency` | `string` | **yes** | The currency of the payment (ISO-4217 code). |
| `description` | `string` | no | A note recorded with the payment. |
| `date` | `string · ISO-8601` | no | When the money was received; not in the future. Sending any of date/method/reference also records the receipt as a successful offline `payment` transaction (gateway `offline_<method>`), and the reply carries its id as `transaction`. Defaults to now. |
| `method` | `string` | no | How the money arrived. Defaults to other One of `cash`, `check`, `bank_transfer`, `other`. |
| `reference` | `string` | no | e.g. the cheque number; stored as the transaction's id_at_gateway |
